analysis.visual_description: The head of Navarre's part, held open on a bench in the tiring-parlour. The first line is clear. The rest is not in the frame. No face, and no hand.
The same line. No word is written beside it. A rain-spot from the yard door has dried at the edge of the paper, not on the ink.
The corner of the part. The hour, and no tally.
